Does it Have UPS Function

Connect the electrical device to the AC output port of the portable power station, and connect the portable power station to a household wall outlet using the AC charging cable. In the event of a power outage, the unit is equipped with a UPS function that automatically switches to battery power within 20 ms (0.02 seconds). Even during a sudden power failure, power supply can continue within the remaining battery capacity of the portable power station. Please note: This function is not a 0 ms (no interruption) switching UPS. Do not connect devices that require a true uninterruptible power supply, such as data servers or workstations.
